name: Vol'jin
summary: In Orgrimmar, Vol'jin advises Warchief Thrall while seeking a lasting home for his people. The Darkspear chieftain is a master shadow hunter.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Darkspear
sections.body: Vol'jin leads the Darkspear after his father, Sen'jin, dies on their ancestral island. Sea witch-worshipping murlocs and human forces nearly destroy the isolated tribe, but Thrall's orcs intervene and forge a deep bond with the trolls. After fleeing the ruined islands, Vol'jin pledges his people to the New Horde and brings them across the Great Sea to Kalimdor.

sections.title: Council in the Valley of Wisdom
sections.body: The Darkspear settle in Durotar, but Zalazane's betrayal on the Echo Isles drives many refugees to the mainland at Sen'jin Village. Vol'jin spends much of his time in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, giving Thrall his strategic counsel and shadow hunter skill. From the orcish capital, he watches over the young Horde and works to reclaim his people's lands.

faq.answer: Vol'jin leads the Darkspear troll tribe and advises Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. A skilled shadow hunter, he represents his people among the Horde's leaders.
Vol'jin lives in Grommash Hold, in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, beside Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear join the Horde?
faq.answer: During the Third War, Thrall's fleet washed ashore on the Darkspear Islands. The orcs allied with the trolls against hostile humans and a fanatical murloc army. After Sen'jin died, Vol'jin pledged his tribe to Thrall, and the Darkspear followed the Horde to Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why aren't the Darkspear living on their own islands?
aliases: why are trolls in senjin village
faq.answer: After settling on the Echo Isles off Durotar, the witch doctor Zalazane was driven mad by dark magic. He enslaved his fellow tribesmen, forcing Vol'jin and the surviving Darkspear to flee to Sen'jin Village on the mainland.

angles.text: As a troll, you have Vol'jin as your chieftain. He guides the displaced Darkspear through hardship with spiritual wisdom and tactical resolve.
As a member of the Horde, you have Vol'jin beside Thrall, offering cunning counsel and the fierce loyalty of the jungle trolls.
